features: thermal sensor: 256x192, NETD <40mK at F1.0, fixed focal 3.6mm F1.0, 50 deg HOV / 37.3 deg VOV
deep-learning AI: people/vehicle detection, intrusion, tampering, line crossing, enter/exit area
fire detection (range 43.2m), smoking detection (range 5.4m), sun-reflection filter
radiometric temperature measurement: point/area/line, up to 21 rules, range -20 to 150C, accuracy +/-8C, detection range 58.3m
analytics detection range: people 28.8m, vehicle 75.6m; observation range: people detect 150m/recognize 38m/identify 19m, vehicle detect 460m/recognize 112m/identify 56m
ONVIF Profile G only (not S/T -- thermal-specific radiometric profile)
2-way audio via Mic-in/Line-out 3.5mm jacks, no built-in microphone or speaker
1x RS-485 serial, 2/2 digital I/O, 1x BNC analog video output (installation only)
corrosion protection optional (~3 years at seashore)
